table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Godown=Godown.Name,
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	Item.PackUnits,   
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),   
	Expiry = MIN(GodownDetail.Expiry),
	packing=itempacking.name,
	packprice=Item.Saleprice
FROM 
	GodownDetail,
	Manufacturer,   
	Item ,
	Itempacking,
	Godown 
WHERE 
	( GodownDetail.GCode IN (:ai_gcode) ) AND
	( GodownDetail.GCode = Godown.GCode ) AND
	( Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode ) AND 
	( Item.packCode IN (:ai_packcode )) AND
	( Item.packcode=itempacking.packcode) AND
	( Manufacturer.manfcode = Item.ManfCode ) AND
	( Item.active=1) 
GROUP BY 
	Godown.Name,
	itempacking.name, 
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active,
	Item.saleprice,
	Item.PackUnits
ORDER BY 
	Godown,
	itempacking.name,
	item.name
